title: Canonical runtime names (daemon, MCP, env)
summary: Frozen canonical identifiers vs deprecated aliases for daemon binary, environment variables, crate names, and MCP tool prefixes; prevents split-brain naming across CLI/MCP/docs/contracts.
notes: Reference/registry document defining canonical naming convention. Frontmatter status=current. Does not propose requirements or constraints; it registers names and maps deprecated aliases. Role is as a lookup table that prevents naming split-brain, not as a binding specification.
